# CLIP STUDIO ASSETS

> A digital art marketplace offering curated brushes, 3D models, animations, and creative resources for Clip Studio Paint users across multiple creative disciplines.

CLIP STUDIO ASSETS serves digital artists with a comprehensive library of professional-grade materials including brushes, 3D character models, animation assets, and design elements. The platform features curated collections organized by creative discipline and maintains community standards through content moderation policies.

## Getting Started

- [CLIP STUDIO ASSETS](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us): Homepage for CLIP STUDIO ASSETS digital art marketplace with brushes, 3D models, and creative resources
- [Help](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/help): FAQ and user guide for asset library, downloads, purchasing, and Clippy currency

## Recommended Materials by Discipline

- [Recommended Materials for Drawing & Painting](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/recommended-materials/drawing-and-painting): Curated collection of recommended brushes and painting materials for digital art creation
- [Recommended Materials for Comics & Manga](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/recommended-materials/comics-and-manga): Recommended assets for manga and comics creation including brushes and backgrounds
- [Recommended Materials for Animation](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/recommended-materials/animation): Recommended animation assets including loops, character animation, and reference materials
- [Recommended 3D Materials](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/recommended-materials/three-d): Curated 3D character models, poses, and backgrounds for Clip Studio Paint
- [Recommended Materials for Design & Patterns](https://assets.clip-studio.com/en-us/recommended-materials/design-and-patterns): Curated design and pattern materials including brushes, gradients, and decorative effects
